findings.description: The requirement has no deadline for sending the reset-cause start-up message after classification. OP-SYS-001 defers that deadline, so an observer cannot determine when the obligation has failed.

CON-SUP-124 places the program CRC reference outside the checked application range. SYS-SUP-016 identifies the reference and range but does not state that separation. CON-SUP-107 also limits the application image to 1 MiB; SYS-SUP-058 specifies a check time for a 1 MiB image but does not limit the image size.
findings.requested_change: Capture or explicitly disposition the program CRC reference placement and maximum application image size from CON-SUP-124 and CON-SUP-107.
